author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
This week, I’m in one of China’s most underrated mountain regions: the canyons of Enshi in Hubei Province. Most people have heard of Zhangjiajie, home of the iconic “Avatar Mountains,” but very few know about the dramatic canyon landscapes around Enshi County.
This is a classic Karst region, part of a vast geological system that stretches from central China all the way down to Ha Long Bay in Vietnam.
The landscape is defined by towering cliffs, deep valleys, and dramatic limestone formations. Much of it was formed by underground rivers and massive cave systems. Over time, some of these caves collapsed, creating sinkholes and the steep-walled canyons we see today.
Join me on this adventure in central China 🇨🇳
